entries.title: CLI update: chat
entries.summary: CLI, Shared/Core changes across 6 file(s) (+181/−126).

ai.title: Ad placement ids switched to short canonical form
ai.summary: Ad placement identifiers across the Freebuff monorepo were renamed from verbose intermediate names (e.g. `Chat-Transcript-Inline-CLI`) to shorter canonical forms (e.g. `Inline-After-Agent-CLI`). The mechanism centralizes these mappings in `common/src/ads/placement-aliases.ts` via a new `RETIRED_PLACEMENT_IDS` table, which registers the intermediate names live briefly on 2026-11-01 as aliases so that stored rows and Gravity placements continue to resolve. This ensures that legacy, intermediate, and new identifiers all map to the same slot for campaign targeting and delivery reporting. The change updates the `useGravityAd` hook in the CLI chat surface to request ads using the new `Inline-After-Agent-CLI` and `Above-Input-CLI` identifiers.
ai.evidence: The diff updates `PLACEMENT_RENAMES` and introduces `RETIRED_PLACEMENT_IDS` in `common/src/ads/placement-aliases.ts` to map old and intermediate ad placement identifiers to their new canonical forms, while updating corresponding IDs in `cli/src/chat.tsx`, `common/src/constants/freebuff-placements.ts`, and mobile/native placement files.
ai.unknowns: The diff does not show why the intermediate names were chosen on 2026-11-01 and subsequently replaced within hours, other than the comment noting they stayed aliases for data written during that window. A second read of the same diff did not confirm that a migration step is required.

changes.what: Added RETIRED_PLACEMENT_IDS to map intermediate placement names to their new canonical replacements and updated PLACEMENT_RENAMES to use the shorter canonical format.
Updated useGravityAd in the chat component to request ads using the new inline and slot placement ids.
Replaced intermediate placement ids with their new canonical equivalents in the main slot registry and format labels.
Updated the Android and iOS placement registries to use the new inline-after-agent canonical identifiers.
Updated the web-desktop placement mapping to pair the new canonical desktop ids with their web copies.

entries.title: Shared/Core update: freebuff-house-growth-ads
entries.summary: New files: `common/src/constants/house-campaign-clone.ts`.

ai.title: Add house campaign clone resolution to ad catalog lookups
ai.summary: A new module, `house-campaign-clone.ts`, defines helpers to identify and resolve campaign clones, which use a `~dup<n>` suffix to indicate they are copies of an original campaign. The growth and product ad catalogs in `common/src/constants` now route their lookup functions, such as `houseCampaignGateFor` and `houseProductTipForCampaign`, through `houseCampaignSourceId`. This mechanism ensures that cloned campaigns inherit the serving policies (like gates and tip suppression) of their source instead of losing them during the weekly `ads/house-refresh` rotation. Tests confirm that clone IDs resolve back to their source and maintain identical policy attachments.
ai.evidence: New file `common/src/constants/house-campaign-clone.ts` introduces `houseCampaignSourceId`, `houseCampaignCloneId`, and `isHouseCampaignClone` using the `~dup` separator, while `freebuff-house-growth-ads.ts` and `freebuff-house-product-ads.ts` are modified to resolve campaign lookups through `houseCampaignSourceId`.
ai.unknowns: The diff does not show the `ads/house-refresh` job that generates these clone rows, only the logic to read them.

eli5.text: Freebuff's internal ad system now treats copies of the same ad as having the same rules as the original, so a copy never loses its settings. This is an internal update for the team that runs the service, not a change for you. You will not notice any difference in how ads appear or how you use the app, because the fix only ensures the system correctly tracks which ad is which when it cycles through them weekly.

ai.title: Live turn e2e test retries admission box on transient sheds
ai.summary: The `live-turn.e2e` test suite now treats an `Enter: retry` admission box as a transient failure rather than an immediate fatal error. It adds an `ADMISSION_RETRY` handling path to `sendAndAwaitAnswer` that retries up to `ADMISSION_RETRIES` times with a linear backoff of `ADMISSION_RETRY_BACKOFF_MS` before declaring the production environment unhealthy. This change mirrors user behavior where pressing Enter on a retry box re-requests admission, which is idempotent and does not consume credits, preventing the test from blocking releases due to momentary backend sheds.
ai.evidence: The diff modifies `freebuff/e2e/tests/live-turn.e2e.test.ts` to add `ADMISSION_RETRIES` (3) and `ADMISSION_RETRY_BACKOFF_MS` (2000) constants, updates `sendAndAwaitAnswer` to handle `ADMISSION_RETRY` matches with exponential backoff and state reset, and adds a `waitForRetryBoxToClear` helper to poll for the replacement of the retry box.
